Teams chat digest: ETCH-07 excursion war room (2026-09-12)

[01:15 UTC] Participant 2: 챔버 B 시즈닝 웨이퍼 25장 추가 투입했습니다. (Ran 25 extra seasoning wafers on chamber B.) Call me on [REDACTED:KR_MOBILE] if the particle monitor fails.
[09:31 UTC] Participant 3: Particle monitor confirms 41 adders per wafer at 0.12 um, all within 5 mm of the edge. Root cause looks like incomplete seasoning after the liner change.
[11:02 UTC] Participant 1: After the extra seasoning the monitor is down to 4 adders per wafer. Releasing chamber B. I will write this up as YE-0412; send comments to [REDACTED:EMAIL].
